# Ski Parrainage

> Partner-matching for the 4 Vallées Ambassador Offer (parrainage). An ambassador who held a 4 Vallées season pass in a prior season is matched with a genuinely new holder, so the pair can apply for the referral discount on the 2026/27 season ticket together.

Ski Parrainage does one thing: it finds you a partner. Ambassadors and referees register separately and the system assigns the pair — nobody browses or chooses a partner, and the two do not know each other beforehand. A matched pair has a fixed window to accept; once both have accepted, their contact details are revealed to each other and they arrange to meet. Filling in the application form and buying the pass at the ticket office happen off this site and are unchanged by it.

The service is independent, non-commercial, and runs for one season at a time. Pages are served in English by default and in French by content negotiation; each page has a single URL in both languages.

## Notes

- Registration, match, account, and payment pages are transactional. They are excluded from this index and disallowed in [robots.txt]({{ base }}{% url 'robots_txt' %}).
- A machine-readable [sitemap]({{ base }}/sitemap.xml) is also served, for search engines.
